notes.title: Snow Spartans 60% off - Winter holiday update!
notes.content:
This time of year the stick spartans wear trapper hats to keep their heads warm and out of the snow. 

This holiday season Stick spartans wear warm hats and use sticks made from candycane!

This new update comes with tons of UI fixes and resolution improvements with dynamic scaling.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32845862/556b302db157a531195e4b7970bee51da061ac5a.png[/img]

Enjoy :P

notes.title: Spook Spartans!
notes.content:
Its night time in game and now all the Spartans are Ghosts trick or treating! 
This update includes multiple bug fixes around UI scale, steam achievements and data storage. 

Enjoy :P

notes.title: First Major Update Released!
notes.content:
Three new game modes added!

New modes:
[list]
    [*]Capture the flag
    [*]King of the Hill
    [*]Insta-Kill
[/list]

These three new modes can be accessed in the play menu.
Minor UI updates have been patched.

In a few days a minor update will follow.

notes.title: Next update sneak peek!
notes.content:

If you have any sugestions for new features feel free to add them to the discussion thread and they might get implemented in this update :P

notes.title: Released!
notes.content:
Stick Spartans is now available for purchase on the steam store! 

There is a 10% discount until June 23rd. 

If you find any bugs you can post a discussion and ill try get back to you as soon as possible. 

Have fun playing! :P
